notes: The passive is handled as specified — the by-phrase takes the Agent role the active subject would have had, the noun-modifier compound 'feed pipe' is fused with only its head genus exposed, and singular collective 'a crew' stays one participant with no GroupOf and no distribution rule. The bare simple present yields no status atom while the indefinite subject yields a witness, so the clause records as an unmarked (generic/habitual) event about a specific witness; that tension is what the two rules jointly force rather than a parse choice.
